create_coefficient_mapping: create a CoefficientMapping module to map spherical harmonic coefficients between degree l and order m representations
get_coefficient_indices: get coefficient indices for a given maximum degree l and order m using CoefficientMapping.coefficient_idx
compute_complex_indices: compute real and imaginary part indices for a specific order m using CoefficientMapping.complex_idx
transform_irreps_to_grid: transform an irreps embedding tensor to a 2D grid representation using SO3_Grid.to_grid
transform_grid_to_irreps: transform a 2D grid tensor back to irreps representation using SO3_Grid.from_grid
